why_this_version_exists: pipeline/train_asr.py load_mix takes a SINGLE manifest version and refuses a mixed set. Replaying the incumbent seven alongside the four Cameroon languages is therefore impossible without one version that holds both. The constraint is the single-version interface, not any one line.

constraints_the_future_packet_must_satis: MEDZEN_EXCLUSIONS_REF must point at the DQ-2026-006 policy object. gb10's adoption records a deferral policy, so load_mix refuses any run that does not supply the matching exclusions — the cp1 pilot packets left this unset and would fail against gb10.

The packet CANNOT use the 'multilingual-full' execution mode. scripts/b5_sagemaker_job.py hard-binds that mode to dataset version gb9, temperature exactly 0.5, and the frozen seven-language set, so an eleven-language run at temperature 0 is refused on three separate counts.
MEDZEN_TEMPERATURE=0 and MEDZEN_AUDIO_CAP_HOURS=15, set explicitly, never inherited.
One trainer image for both arms, so initialisation is not confounded with code as it was in the pilot.

Training remains gated on the ASR scorer normaliser fix being committed and tested.

publish_adoption.py was NOT used: it is v2-era and requires a policy carrying a bindings block with v2_complete_raw_sha256, which DQ-2026-006 does not have. gb9's own adoption was not produced by it either. The record was written directly in the same shape gb9 and cp1 use, with the same conditional-put guarantee the script provides.
